feedback: This candidate repeats the controller and geometry from iteration 4, which was approved and raced but showed no improvement on the slalom track, with zero finishes and significant line loss events (iteration 4 outcome). The cautious tuning trend of lowering base speed to 1.5, setting kp to 4, and kd to 8 did not resolve the stability and line tracking issues on the most challenging track. Given this, the current candidate is unlikely to improve performance without further changes. If the next race confirms persistent steering oscillations and line loss events, consider revising the controller gains by lowering kp to 3 and increasing kd to 9 to enhance damping and reduce oscillations, as suggested by iteration 3 evidence. Also, if progress remains low or unstable, cautiously increase base speed to 1.6 to improve forward motion and stability balance. Sensor weights and line loss strategy have not shown issues and can remain unchanged. Geometry is stable and effective, so no changes are recommended there. This candidate is valid but not expected to outperform the best raced design yet. Depending on the next race results, these changes should be considered to improve slalom track performance.
requested_changes: controller.kp=3 (if oscillations persist, to reduce responsiveness and oscillations, iteration 3 evidence)
controller.kd=9 (to increase damping and reduce oscillations, iteration 3 evidence)
controller.base_speed=1.6 (if progress is low or unstable, to improve speed and stability balance, iteration 3 evidence)
